messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — ACME just surfaced org SSO + VPC for their pilot. Sales says it's a blocker for a 4/20 pilot start. Need fast decision on MVP vs v1 and a rollout path.
Jordan (Sales): Confirming: they want SSO (SAML), dedicated VPC, and audit logs. If we can't show progress, they may delay.
Anna (Product): That's a big ask for MVP. Can we carve out a minimal pilot surface that keeps them happy without full Private?
Ravi (Eng): Quick engineering take: SAML SSO + metadata endpoint + basic audit logs = ~2 sprints if we reassign dev capacity. Full VPC and private control plane with KMS = ~6+ weeks, infra-heavy.
Evan (Infra): +1. VPC requires KMS work, tenancy isolation tests, egress controls, and infra runbooks. We could offer a managed "pilot VPC" as a stopgap but it's ~4 weeks and higher ops cost.
Sam (Design): SSO UX: we can ship a lightweight flow — settings page, upload metadata, login flow. I'll mock it today. No blocker.
Maya (PM): Options: A) Ship SSO + audit in MVP, VPC in v1; B) Delay pilot and deliver both in v1; C) Make a narrow managed-VPC pilot to keep date. Which is realistic?
Jordan (Sales): Customer prefers A if Legal signs data boundary notes. They'll accept host-managed network for pilot if we provide guarantees and SOC-type docs.
Anna (Product): Let's build a tight acceptance criteria list for the pilot to avoid scope creep: what is included vs reserved for v1.
Ravi (Eng): Breakdowns: SAML endpoints + test harness (2 devs, 2 weeks). KMS + orchestration + tests (infra+sec, 6 weeks). Managed-VPC fallback (reduced surface) ~4 weeks but riskier.
Evan (Infra): Dependencies to call out: internal KMS integration, key rotation docs, tenancy isolation test suite. If we try managed-VPC, we'll need ops on-call for pilot.
Maya (PM): Proposed decision: move SSO + audit logs into MVP (pilot) scope, schedule VPC and KMS for v1. Add formal pilot guardrails: no PHI, limited tenant count, explicit rollback SLA.
Sam (Design): I'll produce SSO mockups + copy for pilot one-pager by EOD.
Ravi (Eng): If we reallocate sprint capacity, I can target SSO+audit in two weeks. We'll deprioritize embeddings-cache perf and admin UX polish.
Anna (Product): I'll publish a cutlist of deferred items so cuts are explicit. No surprise scope shifting.
Jordan (Sales): ACME tentatively approves A. They want a one-pager and legal checklist detailing what's in pilot vs v1.
Maya (PM): Action items: @Anna publish cutlist + pilot one-pager; @Ravi itemize tasks + confirm deps; @Evan scope managed-VPC as fallback; @Sam ship mocks. Reconvene in 24h.
DeployBot: Reminder — sprint planning meeting in 48h (https://calendar.redwood/next-sprint).
Ravi (Eng): Starting eng-platform thread for KMS/tenant test capture.
Evan (Infra): I'll draft a managed-VPC runbook and cost/ops note in #eng-infra in ~4h.
Anna (Product): Posted cutlist draft: 1) Keep SSO + audit logs in MVP pilot, 2) Delay embeddings cache improvements, 3) Move admin polish to v1. Link (internal): https://docs.redwood/internal/pilot-cutlist
Jordan (Sales): ACME wants legal checklist by next Tue. I'll loop in their security contact.
Maya (PM): Noted — if legal requires stronger data residency/encryption, we may need to revisit the plan. For now: MVP = SSO + audit logs + pilot checklist; v1 = VPC/private deployment + KMS integration + tenancy hardening.
Sam (Design): Dropping SSO flow + one-pager copy in the shared drive shortly. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng): I'll open a thin PR with SAML endpoints and a basic test harness within 48h.
Evan (Infra): Posting managed-VPC cost/ops plan in #eng-infra in ~4h.
Maya (PM): Thanks team. We'll keep timeline optimistic but document risks for stakeholders. Reconvene 24h. :eyes:
